uplink.description: Status report: 3.6 V, input0 0.005 V, input1 0.003 V
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r718ib2 codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3.6, ADCRawValue1 5, ADCRawValue2 3. byte3 0x24 -> 3.6 V; bytes[4..5]=5 mV -> input0 analog.voltage 0.005 V; bytes[6..7]=3 mV -> input1 analog.voltage 0.003 V. Each input terminal's reading is a channels[] entry; battery stays top-level. Satisfies analog-interface.

uplink.description: Both inputs mid/full scale: 3.6 V, input0 7.5 V, input1 9.999 V
uplink._note: Synthetic two-input frame in the TTN status-report shape (device id 0x42), with distinct per-input values across the 0-10 V range so the entries cannot be transposed unnoticed. Upstream oracle semantics: ADCRawValue1 = bytes[4..5] = 0x1D4C = 7500 mV -> input0 7.5 V; ADCRawValue2 = bytes[6..7] = 0x270F = 9999 mV -> input1 9.999 V.
